_doc: Exact spec + full describe/title quarantine; the title identifies the affected backend or viewport suite.
Only this known test may pass on retry. Other tests in the spec remain blocking.
owner is the accountable GitHub user; evidence links the observed failed run.
expires is inclusive UTC; after this date flakes block again. Review before expiry using the measured exit criteria; never extend automatically.
Missing or invalid policy fields fail closed. The spec still gets an isolated retrying shard while its exact-test policy is active.

quarantine.why: CI 38833820199 observed 3766 differing pixels in the phone title, around lower-door compositing and the sound glyph; the other five goldens passed. Prior CI on f63c2ff10 and scoped local captures on Chromium 153 and 154 passed unchanged goldens. The precise cause remains unresolved; capture-state diagnostics retain masks, pseudo-elements, fonts and browser identity. Persistent mismatches still fail. Renewed 2026-10-22 (W3): no new failure of this test has been recorded since run 38833820199 (the only evidence), so the cause is still unresolved and cannot be fixed without a failing capture-state artifact to diff; the diagnostics added by the spec stay in place.

quarantine.why: llvmpipe, intermittent; three causes in turn, each named by the texture-creation log. (1) Run 39415873380 (2026-10-20): 1 texture on the post-pause edit; the 1.5 s live-atlas trace tick re-created its 512² texture, fixed by #3205 refillTexture. (2) Run 39501456087 (2026-10-20 21:36Z, after #3205): one 1024×1280 texture, the player decal-atlas preview; the draft-keyed decal fix 45d576dd followed. (3) Run 39876864967 (2026-10-23 00:16Z, after both fixes; job 120164712044, first try and retry): two textures on the post-pause edit, 1024² and 512², the garage bay dress atlas (scene-dress.js DRESS) and live atlas (scene-live.js LIVE), both created by three on first draw (Rb._createBindings → updateTexture). scene.js frees and re-creates both on every paint edit; the TLX _texPool reuse was missed. Since then: 37 cold llvmpipe first-try passes and no failure (scan of every ci.yml/pages.yml run 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-25, docs/notes/FLAKY-QUARANTINE-3505-2026-10-25.md). Renewed 2026-10-25 by B·W1·L1 (#3505 row 1).
